row: Radha Madhav Sewa Kunj - Animal rescue center Una

Welcome to our channel, where every view supports a life saved! 

Our animal rescue center serves as a sanctuary for animals like cow, bull, dog, cats and any other stray in need, providing them with shelter, medical care, and love. In any emergency our helpline number is +91 93175-50543.

Join us on a journey of compassion and hope as we document our team's efforts in rescuing and rehabilitating animals in need. From heartwarming rescue missions to heart wrenching rehabilitation stories, our channel offers a window into the incredible work being done to give animals a second chance at life. Through engaging videos, you'll witness the transformative power of love and dedication, as we strive to make the world a better place for all creatures great and small. Subscribe today and become a part of our community of animal lovers making a difference, one rescue at a time.
